newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW says plans 35.6 blm mks investments 1997-2001.
newsitem.headline: VW says plans 35.6 blm mks investments 1997-2001.

text.p: German carmaker Volkswagen AG said on Monday that its supervisory board has approved a five-year plan from 1997 to 2001 that calls for 35.6 billion marks in investments.
The amount is an increase from the 1996-2000 period level of 32.3 billion marks, the Wolfsburg-based carmaker said.
VW said further development of its vehicle model policy would be at the centre of its planning and that most of the spending would be concentrated on its product development.
The carmaker also said Germany would have "special meaning" in its investment strategy but did not elaborate further.
